projectDescription: A CLI and web-based tool to crawl, download, and convert light novels from 360+ online sources into e-book formats like EPUB, MOBI, PDF, and more.
keyFeatures: Download light novels from 360+ supported online sources across multiple languages
Export to multiple e-book formats: EPUB, MOBI, PDF, DOCX, RTF, FB2, AZW3, and more
Interactive CLI with terminal prompts and non-interactive batch mode
Web server UI with REST API for remote access and browser-based management
Bot integrations for Discord and Telegram
Cloudflare bypass and browser automation for JS-heavy sites
Concurrent chapter downloading with configurable worker threads
Search novels across supported sources by query string
publicApiSurface: lncrawl crawl [URL] - Download chapters from a novel URL
lncrawl search [QUERY] - Search for novels by keyword
lncrawl server - Start the web server (default port 8080)
lncrawl sources - Manage and list available sources
lncrawl config - View and modify configuration settings
Crawler.read_novel_info() - Abstract method to fetch novel metadata
Crawler.download_chapter_body() - Abstract method to fetch chapter content
Crawler.search_novel() - Optional method for search support
Crawler.login() - Optional method for authenticated sources
GeneralSoupTemplate - Base class for BeautifulSoup-based crawlers
SearchableSoupTemplate - Base class for searchable crawlers
